questions.cardText:
[History] Before becoming a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement, what was Mahatma Gandhi’s profession?
A. Doctor B. Lawyer C. Teacher
Answer: B. Mahatma Gandhi was a trained lawyer who practiced law in South Africa and India. His experiences with racial discrimination and injustice in South Africa inspired him to lead social movements, developing his philosophy of nonviolent resistance to fight for social justice and independence.
questions.de: Welchen Beruf übte Mahatma Gandhi in Südafrika und Indien aus, bevor er zu einem Anführer der indischen Unabhängigkeitsbewegung wurde?
questions.en: What was Mahatma Gandhi's profession, practised in South Africa and India, before he became a leader of the Indian independence movement?

timeline.labelEn: Mahatma Gandhi, lawyer and leader of the Indian independence movement
timeline.labelDe: Mahatma Gandhi, Rechtsanwalt und Anführer der indischen Unabhängigkeitsbewegung

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] Which of the following is a rock that can have any composition?
A. Pumice B. Basalt C. Mica
Answer: A. Pumice is a texture of rock of unspecified composition. Basalt is a rock with a specific composition and minerals, while mica is a family of minerals.
questions.de: Wie heißt das schaumige, stark blasige vulkanische Gesteinsglas, das über seine Textur statt über eine feste Zusammensetzung bestimmt ist und so leicht ist, dass es auf Wasser schwimmt?
questions.en: What name is given to the frothy, highly vesicular volcanic glass that is defined by its texture rather than a fixed composition and is light enough to float on water?

timeline.labelEn: After the eruption of Krakatoa, rafts of floating pumice drift across the Indian Ocean for up to 20 years
timeline.labelDe: Nach dem Ausbruch des Krakatau treiben Flöße aus schwimmendem Bimsstein bis zu 20 Jahre lang durch den Indischen Ozean

questions.notes: Card slightly overstates: Wikipedia says pumice is commonly, but not exclusively, silicic/felsic to intermediate (basaltic pumice exists) — a textural name rather than a compositional one. Question reworked around texture + floating to keep one answer.
